title: card.effect@1
description: Receipt for the effects a resolved card ran (card.effect.completed or card.effect.failed). Idempotent per card id and revision. By v1 convention the fields are ids and codes, with no free text (CW-20261023-0001); this is descriptive, not enforced by the catalog. The schema stays open: unknown fields and arbitrary strings validate. Enforcement is the producer's and Tachyon's server-side browser projection.

revision.description: Card revision this event describes; responses are compare-and-set on it.

op_digest.description: Digest over the exact change set a card's effects may run, where the card has effects.

source_app.description: App that owns the card, derived from the verified credential subject, never self-asserted.

code.description: Error or result code, never message text.
